items.item_text: 01. Do you possess a Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution in Communications, Journalism, Public Relations, Marketing, Digital Media, Sports Management, Broadcasting, Media Production, or a closely related field, OR an equivalent combination of directly related education, training, and experience? Options: Yes | No

02. Do you have at least three (3) years of relevant experience in athletics communications, sports information, digital media, creative content, photography, video production, broadcasting, marketing, public relations, social media content creation, or a closely related field? Options: Yes | No

03. Are you able to work part-time, including evenings, weekends, and other nontraditional hours, and travel to select athletic competitions as required by assigned athletic schedules? Options: Yes | No
04. Do you have legal authorization to work in the United States? Options: Yes | No
